classification.difficultyReason: Conserve the total volume of three spheres and reverse the sphere volume formula.

content.prompt:
Three metal spheres are melted down and made into one bigger sphere.
What is the radius of the bigger sphere?

spec.description: Three unshaded spherical silhouettes in a left-to-right row, increasing in size, with corresponding radius labels beneath.
spec.mathematics: Three spheres have radii 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Original radii only; the resulting radius is absent.

answer.worked:
The total volume is unchanged when the metal is melted.
$$\begin{align*}V_{\text{total}}&=\frac43\pi\times6^3+\frac43\pi\times8^3+\frac43\pi\times10^3\\V_{\text{total}}&=\frac43\pi(216+512+1000)\\V_{\text{total}}&=2304\pi\text{ cm}^{3}\\\frac43\pi R^3&=2304\pi\\R^3&=1728\\R&=12\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
